Count to Twenty!

I can count to twelve!
One, two, three…
up to twelve!
🦝 Easy!
Thirteen, fourteen, fifteen!
More fireflies —
count them up!
🦝 More lights!
Sixteen, seventeen, eighteen!
Even more —
glow, glow, glow!
🐰 So many!
Nineteen… TWENTY!
The jar is full —
twenty fireflies!
🦝 Twenty!
Twenty little lights!
Glowing warm and bright —
one to twenty!
🦝 Beautiful!
Off they go!
Twenty fireflies fly up —
bye-bye! Into the stars!
🦝🐶🐰 Wow!
I can count to twenty!
One to twenty —
count with Speaky!
🦝🐶🐰 Hooray!
